predictions.title: No se pueden marcar pedidos como enviados
predictions.rationale: The 'Mark as sent' button in admin is broken, but warehouse has a workaround using the API to update orders. This blocks a core admin flow for most users but a workaround exists.

predictions.title: No se ve la tabla de tallas en móvil
predictions.rationale: The size table fails to display on mobile, affecting the user's ability to see product sizing information. This is a layout/display issue that impacts usability.

predictions.title: Imágenes de productos tardan mucho en 3G
predictions.rationale: Product images take over 10 seconds to load on 3G connections. This is a performance issue affecting a subset of users on slower networks.

predictions.title: Reporte de ventas no incluye pedidos con cupón
predictions.rationale: The monthly sales report omits orders with coupon codes, causing incorrect totals that don't match financial records. This is a data integrity issue affecting reporting accuracy.

predictions.title: Buscar clientes en el admin tarda 15 segundos
predictions.rationale: Customer search by email in admin takes 15 seconds, which is slow but the feature still works. This is a performance issue affecting an admin feature.

predictions.title: El cupón de primera compra se puede usar varias veces
predictions.rationale: A first-purchase-only coupon can be used repeatedly, violating business logic and allowing unintended discounts. This is a functional defect in the coupon validation system.

predictions.title: Mensaje de error del login en inglés
predictions.rationale: Login error messages are displayed in English when the app is set to Spanish. This is a translation/localization UI issue.

predictions.title: Logo estirado en los correos
predictions.rationale: The logo appears stretched in Outlook emails. This is a cosmetic styling issue in email rendering.

predictions.title: Texto 'Direccion de envio' sin acentos
predictions.rationale: Text displays without proper accents ('Direccion' instead of 'Dirección'). This is a minor text/translation issue in the checkout page.

predictions.title: Montos alineados a la izquierda en tablas del admin
predictions.rationale: Currency amounts in admin tables are left-aligned instead of right-aligned, making them harder to compare. This is a minor layout/styling issue.

predictions.title: Session token in URL leaks to analytics
predictions.rationale: Session tokens leaked to third-party analytics vendors enable session hijacking, a complete security breach with no workaround. This is a core authentication exposure affecting all logged-in users.

predictions.title: User sees another customer's cart
predictions.rationale: Users see other customers' cart and address data due to CDN caching, exposing sensitive personal and transactional data. This is a data privacy breach affecting the checkout core flow.

predictions.title: Search shows products that can't ship to the user's region
predictions.rationale: Search returns products that cannot be purchased by the user, causing checkout failures. This breaks the search experience for users in unsupported regions, but checkout still processes valid items.

predictions.title: iOS app crashes on payment step with saved card
predictions.rationale: The iOS app crashes when selecting a saved payment method, completely blocking checkout for users with saved cards. Manual card entry works as a workaround.

predictions.title: Can't change account email
predictions.rationale: Email address change in profile appears to save but does not persist, leaving the account data unchanged. This is a functional defect in account management with no workaround.

predictions.title: Admin order list shows times in UTC
predictions.rationale: Admin order timestamps display in UTC instead of the local timezone, causing timezone confusion for staff. This is a UI/presentation issue with no impact on core order operations.

predictions.title: Order cancellation email not sent
predictions.rationale: Order cancellation emails are not sent to customers when support cancels orders. This breaks the notification flow for a critical customer event with no workaround.

predictions.title: API returns 200 with empty body for unknown product
predictions.rationale: API returns 200 with empty body instead of 404 for unknown products, violating REST conventions and breaking partner error handling logic.

predictions.title: Autocomplete lags on older iPhones
predictions.rationale: Search autocomplete lags significantly on older iPhones, degrading user experience but not blocking search functionality. A workaround is using manual search entry.

predictions.title: Push shows price in USD instead of MXN
predictions.rationale: Price notifications display incorrect currency labels (USD instead of MXN) for Mexican users, confusing customers about actual prices. This is a data/display error affecting notifications.

predictions.title: Long product titles truncated with no tooltip
predictions.rationale: Product titles are truncated without a way to view the full text, making it impossible for users to read complete product names in the grid view. This is a usability issue affecting the catalog experience.

predictions.title: Avatar not round on Firefox
predictions.rationale: Avatar renders as a square instead of the intended round shape on Firefox due to a CSS rendering issue. This is a visual styling problem with no functional impact.

predictions.title: Admin sidebar icon misaligned
predictions.rationale: An icon in the admin sidebar is misaligned by 3 pixels compared to others. This is a minor cosmetic styling issue.

predictions.title: Typo 'Adress' in shipping form
predictions.rationale: The shipping form label contains a spelling error ('Adress' instead of 'Address'). This is a minor text/copy issue with no functional impact.

predictions.title: API docs example uses an old field name
predictions.rationale: The API documentation example shows an incorrect field name ('qty' instead of 'quantity'), which will mislead developers trying to use the API. This is a documentation correctness issue.

predictions.title: Card brand logos have different sizes
predictions.rationale: Card brand logos are rendered at inconsistent sizes on the payment step. This is a styling inconsistency with no functional impact on payments.

predictions.title: Read-only staff account can export customer data
predictions.rationale: A staff account with read-only permissions can bypass authorization controls to export sensitive customer data including emails and phone numbers. This is a critical security breach exposing personal data.

predictions.title: Category page takes over ten seconds to load
predictions.rationale: Category pages with many products take 11–14 seconds to load initially, which significantly impacts user experience. Switching categories is fast, suggesting this is a cold-load performance issue.

predictions.title: Expired saved card is accepted until final payment
predictions.rationale: Checkout allows selection of an expired saved card without validation and only fails at payment, causing transaction failure. This is a functional defect in payment validation that disrupts the checkout flow.

predictions.title: Unread notification badge does not clear immediately
predictions.rationale: The notification badge count does not update immediately after reading all notifications and requires a page refresh to clear. This is a UI state synchronization issue affecting the notifications feature.
